name: Loadify-Preloader
author: Ahsan Riad

sections.description:
Loadify-Preloader 🌀 is a lightweight, customizable WordPress plugin that adds a preloader to your website, creating a smoother user experience by displaying a loading screen as content loads. With flexible settings and design customization, Loadify-Preloader offers everything you need to set up a polished preloader that suits your website’s style. Tailor the look with preset images, colors, and text, and control where it appears—on the homepage, pages, or the entire site.

Key Features:
🟢 One-Click Activation: Enable or disable the preloader with a simple toggle.
🖌️ Customize to Perfection: Change the text, colors, font size, and background to match your site’s style.
🌈 Preset Image Library: Select from a range of stylish loading animations or upload your own.
🎯 Flexible Display Settings: Choose where the preloader shows up—on the homepage, posts, pages, or across the entire site.
⚙️ Easy-to-Use Admin Panel: Configure everything with a clean, intuitive settings interface.

License

sections.installation:
1. 🔽 Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/loadify-preloader directory, or install directly through the WordPress Plugin screen.
  2. ✅ Activate the plugin via the WordPress ‘Plugins’ menu.
  3. ⚙️ Head over to Settings -> Preloader Setting to get started.
  4. 🎨 Personalize your preloader by adjusting text, selecting images, and modifying styles.
  5. 💾 Save your settings, and the preloader will appear exactly where you want it!
sections.faq:
How do I change the preloader image?

🖼️ Simply go to Settings -> Preloader Setting to select from preset images or upload your own custom image.

Can I disable the preloader on specific pages?

📄 Yes! In the settings, specify where the preloader should appear—on specific pages, posts, or across your entire site.

Will this plugin slow down my website?

🚀 Absolutely not! Loadify-Preloader is designed to be lightweight and efficient, ensuring your website’s performance remains fast.
